Nigeria Stack Normative Request for Comments (NS-RFC-001 to NS-RFC-014) Reader

NS-RFC-014: Local Government Service Suite (774 LGAs)

Legal & Operational Summary: Defines the offline-first digital standards for Nigeria's 774 Local Government Councils under Fourth Schedule CFRN powers.

Key Rule 1: All local services MUST work offline via basic mobile phones (*347*LGA#) or printed QR paper credentials (Freedom to Exit).

Key Rule 2: 100% of collected revenue MUST settle directly into the public Local Government Treasury Account without intermediary retention (Supreme Court Ruling SC/CV/343/2024).

Tripartite Working Groups (WG-01 to WG-06)

WG-01: Identity & Consent

Oversees verifiable digital credentials, biometric privacy safeguards, and under-60-second consent revocation mechanisms.

WG-02: Direct Revenue & Treasury Settlement

Maintains zero-escrow payment specifications and direct treasury split algorithms compliant with SC/CV/343/2024.

WG-03: Judiciary & Verifiable Evidence

Defines cryptographic standards for electronic court filing, digital evidence seals, and tamper-proof legal records.

WG-04: Offline & Inclusive Channels

Ensures 100% feature availability across USSD (*347*LGA#), SMS, and paper fallback channels for 2G networks.

WG-05: Open Contracting & Procurement Audit

Standardizes real-time public procurement data schemas and automated civil society audit tools.

WG-06: Sub-National & LGA Interoperability

Coordinates cross-border data exchange protocols across all 36 States, FCT, and 774 Local Government Areas.

Implementation Playbooks (Playbooks A through E)

Playbook A: Civil Registry & Identity Transition

Step-by-step guidance for state and local government registration officers to issue verifiable digital birth and identity credentials.

Playbook B: Direct Revenue Settlement

Financial integration procedures for direct bank-to-treasury payments compliant with Supreme Court ruling SC/CV/343/2024.

Playbook C: Digital Court Filing

Technical setup for state judiciaries to manage digital evidence and verifiable court case filings.

Playbook D: Offline Health & Agriculture Access

Deployment blueprints for rural health clinics and agricultural extensions using feature-phone USSD and SMS fallback channels.

Playbook E: Open Contracting & Public Audit

Instructions for civil society organizations and public auditors to verify public procurement records in real time.

NS-FAQ-01: Is nigeriastack.org a government agency, commercial API marketplace, or payment portal?

Answer: No. nigeriastack.org is an independent, non-profit public open technical specification commons. It does not collect taxes, process payments, operate commercial APIs, or exercise regulatory power.
